review.brief_reason: Distributing 3.17918e-12 over the x0 binomial gives 8.774038334778210e-10*x0 - 8.775934526995078108356e-12. The proposal keeps the x0 coefficient but changes the constant to -8.775934526995079e-12, a nonzero mismatch, so the expressions are not exactly equivalent. Domain and variable identity are unchanged.
